title: The Cartographer's Lantern
statement: They say the first mapmaker of the night sky carried a small lantern so she could see her own star charts — and the sky, charmed that someone finally looked closely enough to draw it, stole the lantern and hung it among the stars. Its flame is the single bright star at its heart; the four fainter stars around it are the corners of a map not yet finished. Sailors claim that when the lantern flickers, a new constellation has just been traced somewhere in the world by someone looking up for the first time.
